lede: San Francisco 49ers carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#5 in EPA per play), while Miami Dolphins owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#25 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it San Francisco 49ers -6.5 with a fair total of 45.7 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is San Francisco 49ers pass offence vs Miami Dolphins pass defence, which sits +0.198 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
